Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: square compact face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; subtle age lines. Hair: dark-brown, asymmetric-extreme, deliberate accent: segmented wrapped crest. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a blunt carpenter's chalk only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
